facts:
## CELL FACTS

Cell 火_偏财 (Fire carrying The Horizon). Persona The Horizon (偏财). Definition line: "Wide-ranging engagement, opportunity sensed at a distance". Keyword Reach, charge dynamic, poles catalyst Momentum / friction Scatter. Family function: Action. Cost dimension: opportunity sensed far off; the near things blur. Arena: horizon, wind, open road, far light, the next place. Classical portrait: wide-ranging engagement; opportunity sensed at a distance; windfall, generosity, the near things blur. Ruled domains: Opportunity, Ventures, Father. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 正财.
Element arena: Fire (flame, light, warmth, fuel, the hearth, the blaze). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Water. structural_interaction seed: "Water directing Fire broadly — depth ranging across warmth as distributed material".
- k2_overview: "Your Fire moves as the Horizon: light that spends itself gladly. Opportunity finds you at gatherings, luck likes your laugh, and money arrives in blazes and leaves by the same door. You are fortune’s favorite dinner guest. Learn to pocket the bread, and the feast never really ends."
- k2_functional: "You seize chances at speed, brilliant in windows, bored in pipelines."
- adj_chips: {"catalyst":["Spark-spotting","Charismatic","Fast-moving"],"friction":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Opportunity":"Chances come to you socially: the tip at the table, the partner met at the party. Keep circulating, it is genuinely your economy. Just write things down before the candles burn out.","Ventures":"Your ventures shine at launch: openings, campaigns, anything with a lit fuse and a crowd. Pair every firework with a caretaker who loves the quiet part. That partnership is your fortune.","Father":"The father-thread flickers warm and irregular: a paternal figure of charisma, generosity, or absence in flares. You inherited the shine and the volatility. Spend the first, insure against the second."}
- fn_reading.friction.ledger (three rows, index-aligned to adj_chips.friction; authored order is significance order):
  - row 0: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 1: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 2: [REDACTED: the target row]
- Sibling cell 火_正财 chips (nothing you write may fit the sibling): {"catalyst":["Warm-handed","Hardworking","Bankable"],"friction":["Tight-fisted","Anxious","Overcareful"]}
- Sibling cell 火_正财 friction row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "The flame gets rationed like the last match. The heating negotiated by degrees, the gift budgeted to the occasion’s minimum, the generosity metered through a nozzle: nothing is ever quite wasted, and nothing is ever quite warm. The savings are real. So is the temperature."

Core element Water, energy element Fire. Law: Water tames Fire (水克火: rain ends the blaze). Relative to the core the energy is the tamed, so Fire is this core's Action. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Water core that shows Fire on the friction pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The friction pole of Fire as the Action is the Underfueled band's case (the core burns more than it takes in); tone by pole: reminder. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. The pair cell 水_火's definition and advice for this pole are rewritten in the same batch (the pair skeleton) and are withheld here; no four-word run may be shared with them, so keep every phrase the ledger's own.
